# Status {.unnumbered}

This is a partial render of the report: it contains only the sections written so far, numbered as in the full report. Build tickets #23 (scaffold, contract pipeline and CI) and #24 (data fetch, weights and YuNet detection) are complete, and #25 has added the dataset analysis behind Section 2 and the minimum usable face size it fixes. #26 measured every recognition model on LFW, and #27 has rehearsed the watchlist on CelebA, frozen each model's threshold and chosen the first active model, which Section 5.2 reports. #28 has compared learning on embeddings with the best-photo rule, put the mean rule live for two models and broken every model's rates down by group, which Sections 5.3 and 5.4 report; it has also written the learned decision rule in Section 6.1 and the methods and limitations it adds to Sections 3 and 8. Section 5.1 and the rest of Sections 3, 6 and 8 are still to be written. #29 and #30 have built the watchlist and the live monitor of the prototype that Section 7 will describe; #31 will add sightings, removal and purge.
